name: POC readiness scorecard
scale: 0 = unknown, 1 = claimed but unverified, 2 = verified by someone on the buyer side, 3 = verified and documented or committed in writing

dimensions.name: Pain is identified and costed
dimensions.ask: What does the problem cost, who feels it, and what happens if nothing changes?

levels.0: No pain stated, or only feature interest
levels.1: Pain mentioned, no cost or owner
levels.2: Pain stated by the buyer with a cost estimate and an owner
levels.3: Cost agreed in a shared document; consequence of inaction acknowledged

dimensions.name: Success metrics agreed
dimensions.ask: Which numbers must move for this to be a success, and by how much?

levels.2: One or more named metrics with a baseline
levels.3: Metrics, baseline, target, and measurement method agreed in writing

dimensions.name: Economic buyer engaged
dimensions.ask: Who approves the spend, and have they heard the case from us or from the champion?

levels.2: Met, and supportive of the pilot
levels.3: Committed budget or a dated decision path, in writing

dimensions.name: Champion with influence and a stake
dimensions.ask: Who wins personally if this works, and what have they done to move it forward?

levels.1: A friendly contact with no influence
levels.2: Influential, shares internal information, coaches us
levels.3: Has sold it internally and made an introduction to the economic buyer

dimensions.name: Decision criteria known
dimensions.ask: What will they use to choose, and who set those criteria?

levels.1: Assumed from the RFP or website
levels.2: Stated by the buyer, partly written down
levels.3: Written criteria, and the POC maps to them

dimensions.name: Decision process mapped
dimensions.ask: What are the steps from POC result to signature, with owners and dates?

levels.3: Steps, owners, and dates agreed, including who can say no

dimensions.name: Paper and security process known
dimensions.ask: Security review, legal, procurement: how long does each take, and has it started?

levels.3: Review already started or pre-approved, with a date

dimensions.name: Alternatives understood
dimensions.ask: What else are they considering, including doing nothing or building in-house?

levels.3: Alternatives known and our differentiation tested with the buyer
